player_prompt.intro:
Nekk d Amurar {player_id} di Nim.
Tigzi-k a d-awi tigzi taneggarut.
Di krayat kray, fayn iyi pile yiwen, d kkes kra n tɣawsiwin-is.
Seqdec asekkil '[pile quantity]', anda pile d aswir n upile, d quantity d uṭṭun n tɣawsiwin ad-ten-kkes.
Amṭag, '[0 3]' ad-ten-kkes 3 n tɣawsiwin seg upile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵢⴰⴼⴰ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵓⵙⴽⴰⵔ ⵉⵣⵔⵉⵏ. ⵙⵎⵔⵙ "[pile quantity]".
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Imcidi {player_id}, Aseqdec ur igawen. Tiɣect {col} tettyaɛ s wakal.
invalid_move.out_of_range: ⴰⵙⵖⵍ ⵏ ⵓⴽⵛⵓⵎ {pile_index} ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴳ ⵓⵙⵡⵉⵔ.
invalid_move.non_positive: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵢⴰⵙⵉ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵓⴷⵎ.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Ur izmir ad yenɣer {quantity} seg tiɣect {pile_index} (kan ṭṭaf {pile_count} icudden).

observation.removed_from_piles: Amarir {player_id} yurar [{pile_index} {quantity}], ad yekkes {quantity} n tiɣawsiwin seg uɣrab {pile_index}.
